name: Propylene U.S. production with PUP-derived propylene
notes:
PUP-derived propylene is produced from cofeeding pyrolysis oil from Nth-plants at 20% susbtitution rate with conventional feedstocks (Naphtha and gases).
Steam crackers' perspective.

Gracida-Alvarez, U.R.; Benavides, P.T.; Lee, U.; Wang, M. (2023) Life-cycle analysis of recycling of post-use plastic to plastic via pyrolysis. Journal of Cleaner Production. In Press.
